**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Aggregate DORA rates from raw records**

For the PRF-G all-project report, taking the median of per-project percentages gives each project equal weight regardless of deployment volume. For example, one service with 1 failed deploy and another with 99 successful deploys reports a 50% change-failure rate here instead of the portfolio rate of 1%, so the manager DORA summary can be materially wrong whenever project deployment counts differ.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve issue/PR events without project IDs**

In the production normalization path, ordinary GitHub `issues` and `pull_request` webhooks do not populate `project_id` because `normalizePmWebhookEvent` only derives project IDs from project/project_v2 fields, so this guard drops the very events now used for throughput. In that scenario closed issues and PRs stored with only `repository`/`subject_id` will never contribute to the manager Throughput card.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Read merged status from stored payload**

This check looks for `merged` or `state` inside `pm_events.normalized`, but `normalizePmWebhookEvent` currently writes only action/projectId/repository/subjectType/subjectId/fromStatus/toStatus there; the GitHub PR `merged` flag remains in `raw_payload`. Even when a PR event is otherwise in scope, real merged PRs will be excluded from `prThroughput` unless they were inserted with the synthetic shape used by the new test.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid reporting unknown rework as zero**

The DB-backed DORA mapping sets `unplannedRework` to `false` for every deployment, so any project with deployments will report a 0.0% deployment rework rate regardless of what actually happened. If the deployments schema does not contain an unplanned-rework signal yet, this should surface as unavailable or be derived from a real source; otherwise the manager report masks rework as a clean zero.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
